package com.platform.events.iam.user;

import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.Map;

public record UserCreatedData(
    String clientId,
    String email,
    String emailDomain,
    boolean isAnchorUser,
    String name,
    String principalId,
    String scope
) {

    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    public static UserCreatedData fromMap(Map<String, Object> map) {
        return new UserCreatedData(
            (String) map.get("clientId"),
            (String) map.get("email"),
            (String) map.get("emailDomain"),
            (Boolean) map.get("isAnchorUser"),
            (String) map.get("name"),
            (String) map.get("principalId"),
            (String) map.get("scope")
        );
    }

    public Map<String, Object> toMap() {
        var map = new LinkedHashMap<String, Object>();
        map.put("clientId", clientId);
        map.put("email", email);
        map.put("emailDomain", emailDomain);
        map.put("isAnchorUser", isAnchorUser);
        map.put("name", name);
        map.put("principalId", principalId);
        map.put("scope", scope);
        return map;
    }
}
